installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ATIVE Casino Bot Installation Script - MariaDB Only
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

echo "🎰 Installing ATIVE Casino Bot (MariaDB Only)..."

# Update package list
apt update

# Install essential build tools and Canvas dependencies
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip libtool

# Install Canvas-specific dependencies
apt install -y libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev libjpeg-dev libgif-dev librsvg2-dev pkg-config

# Install MySQL client for database operations
apt install -y default-mysql-client

echo "📦 Updating npm to latest version..."
npm install npm@latest --location=global

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo "✅ User upload mode - assuming files are already uploaded"
    
    # Create .env from template if it doesn't exist
    if [ -f ".env.pterodactyl" ] && [ ! -f ".env" ]; then
        echo "⚙️ Creating .env from template..."
        cp .env.pterodactyl .env
    fi
    
    # Set permissions for scripts
    if [ -f "startup.sh" ]; then
        chmod +x startup.sh
        echo "🔧 Made startup.sh executable"
    fi
    
    if [ -f "test-db-connection.js" ]; then
        chmod +x test-db-connection.js
        echo "🔧 Made database test script executable"
    fi
    
    if [ -d "scripts" ]; then
        chmod +x scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null || echo "📁 No script files found to make executable"
    fi
    
    # Create necessary directories
    mkdir -p logs backups temp
    echo "📁 Created necessary directories"
    
    exit 0
fi

# Handle Git repository cloning
if [ ! -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    ## add git ending if it's not on the address
    if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
        GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
    fi
    
    if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        echo "📡 Using anonymous Git access"
    else
        GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
        echo "🔑 Using authenticated Git access"
    fi
    
    ## pull git js repo
    if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
        echo "⚠️ /mnt/server directory is not empty."
        if [ -d .git ]; then
            echo "📂 .git directory exists"
            if [ -f .git/config ]; then
                echo "📋 Loading info from git config"
                ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
            else
                echo "❌ Files found with no git config"
                echo "🛑 Exiting without touching files to prevent data loss"
                exit 10
            fi
        fi
        
        if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
            echo "🔄 Pulling latest from repository"
            git pull
        fi
    else
        echo "📥 /mnt/server is empty. Cloning files into repository"
        if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
            echo "🌿 Cloning default branch"
            git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
        else
            echo "🌿 Cloning branch: ${BRANCH}"
            git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
        fi
    fi
else
    echo "⚠️ No GIT_ADDRESS provided - assuming files are manually uploaded"
fi

# Install additional Node packages if specified
echo "📦 Installing additional Node.js packages..."
if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
fi

# Install project dependencies
if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "📋 Installing project dependencies..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm install --production
    
    echo "🎨 Rebuilding Canvas module for container compatibility..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm rebuild canvas || echo "⚠️ Canvas rebuild warning (module may need fresh install)"
    
    echo "✅ Canvas rebuild completed"
else
    echo "⚠️ No package.json found - skipping npm install"
fi

# Setup ATIVE Casino Bot specific files
echo "🎰 Setting up ATIVE Casino Bot..."

# Create .env from template if it doesn't exist
if [ -f ".env.pterodactyl" ] && [ ! -f ".env" ]; then
    echo "⚙️ Creating .env from template..."
    cp .env.pterodactyl .env
fi

# Set permissions for scripts
if [ -f "startup.sh" ]; then
    chmod +x startup.sh
    echo "🔧 Made startup.sh executable"
fi

if [ -f "test-db-connection.js" ]; then
    chmod +x test-db-connection.js
    echo "🔧 Made database test script executable"
fi

if [ -d "scripts" ]; then
    chmod +x scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null || echo "📁 No script files found in scripts directory"
    echo "🔧 Made script files executable"
fi

# Create necessary directories
mkdir -p logs backups temp
echo "📁 Created logs, backups, and temp directories"

echo "🎉 ATIVE Casino Bot installation completed successfully!"
echo "📋 Next steps:"
echo "   1. Configure your MariaDB database credentials in the panel"
echo "   2. Ensure Discord token is set"
echo "   3. Start the server - database connection will be tested automatically"
echo "   4. The bot will create database tables on first successful connection"

exit 0

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description:
GitHub repository URL to clone the bot files from (optional if uploading files manually).

Example: https://github.com/username/ative-casino-bot

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: The branch to clone from the repository.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Set to 1 if you're uploading files manually instead of using Git.

0 = Use Git repository
1 = Files uploaded manually

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description:
Automatically pull latest files from Git repository on startup.

0 = Disabled
1 = Enabled

variables.name: Additional Node Packages
variables.description:
Install additional Node.js packages (space-separated).

Example: lodash moment axios

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Personal Access Token for private repositories (optional).

Generate at: https://github.com/settings/tokens

variables.name: Main File
variables.description: The main JavaScript file that starts the bot.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Discord bot token from Discord Developer Portal. Required for bot authentication.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: Discord application client ID from Discord Developer Portal. Required for slash commands.

variables.name: MariaDB Host
variables.description: MariaDB database host address. Get this from your Pterodactyl panel database section.

variables.name: MariaDB Username
variables.description: MariaDB database username from your Pterodactyl panel database settings. REQUIRED for connection.

variables.name: MariaDB Password
variables.description: MariaDB database password from your Pterodactyl panel database settings. REQUIRED for connection.

variables.name: MariaDB Database Name
variables.description: MariaDB database name. This database must exist in your Pterodactyl panel. REQUIRED.

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Port for health checks and monitoring endpoints.

variables.name: Developer ID
variables.description: Discord user ID for developer/admin access to special commands.

variables.name: Log Channel ID
variables.description: Discord channel ID where the bot will send error logs and admin notifications.
